info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: gatyarTe aniditAM halaH upaDAyAH kNiti 6.4.24 ityanena upaDAnakAralopaH Bavati . pUjanArTe nAYceH pUjAyAm 6.4.30 ityanena nakAralopaH niziDyate .

info.name: English Meaning
info.value: to go, to pray, to honor, to worship, to respect
